saw_lines: Buyers of a mechanical watch compare case size, movement and price before they trust a brand.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line of the ad, before any proof or price is seen.
Your 12 copy ads carry no proof number, so a buyer has nothing to check. Open the next batch with the “more than 100 countries” line from your site.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 27 Oct 2026
points: Your 12 copy ads carry no proof number, so a buyer weighing a mechanical watch has nothing to check. Open the next batch with the “more than 100 countries” line from your site, and add a real count of watches shipped.
18 of your 30 live ads are catalog tiles with no story, so a cold viewer has no reason to stop. Build three story ads on growing up in Venice, each opening on a watch worn on the wrist.

Your site promotes free worldwide shipping, yet 0 of 12 copy ads mention it, so a new buyer has no reason to act today. Put free worldwide shipping in the first line of three new ads for first time buyers.

Your 12 copy ads open 12 different ways, the top opener leads 1 ad, so no hook gets enough runs to show what works. Build the next batch from the two best stories, the Arsenale calendar and the Venice story.

ads_1: Venice roots and Arsenale calendar story ads, built from your two best openers
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and X
